fusions.name: Landfall, Eventually
fusions.desc: Rolls a slow boulder that deals 36 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and always leaves the target [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Creeping Silt
fusions.desc: Silt rises around you, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Settling
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 15% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health to you at once.

fusions.name: Settled Reserve
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you recover 15 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
